column4: trisūtraṃ śāśvataṃ puṇyaṃ bubudhe yaṃ pitāmahaḥ //
sāmānyaṃ ca viśeṣaṃ ca guṇān dravyāṇi karma ca //
atha bhelādayaścakruḥ svaṃ svaṃ tantraṃ kṛtāni ca /
taṃ puṇyaṃ śuśruvuḥ śabdaṃ divi devarṣayaḥ sthitāḥ /
buddhiḥ siddhiḥ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kīrtiḥ kṣamādayā //
mānaṃ ca tacca yatroktamāyurvedaḥ sa ucyate //
sa nityo yatra hi dravyaṃ na tatrāniyato guṇaḥ //
taddravyaṃ samavāyī tu niśceṣṭaḥ kāraṇaṃ guṇaḥ //
saṃyoge ca vibhāge ca kāraṇaṃ dravyamāśritam /
kālabuddhīndriyārthānāṃ yogo mithyā na cāti ca /
tathā sukhānāṃ yogastu sukhānāṃ kāraṇaṃ samaḥ //
caitanye kāraṇaṃ nityo draṣṭā paśyati hi kriyāḥ //
mānasaḥ punaruddiṣṭo rajaśca tama eva ca //
rūkṣaḥ śīto laghuḥ sūkṣmaścalo 'atha viśadaḥ kharaḥ /
sasnehamuṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca dravamamlaṃ saraṃ kaṭu /
nirvṛttau ca viśeṣe ca pratyayāḥ khādayastrayaḥ //
suvarṇaṃ samalāḥ pañca lohāḥ sasikatāḥ sudhā /
kṣārāḥ kṣīraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ bhasma tailāni kaṇṭakāḥ //
ya etān vetti saṃyoktuṃ vikāreṣu sa vedavit //
jyotiṣmatī ca bimbī ca śaṇapuṣpī viṣāṇikā /
ajagandhā dravantī ca kṣīriṇī cātra ṣoḍaśī //
śaṇapuṣpī ca bimbī ca cchardane haimavatyapi /
ānūpaṃ sthalajaṃ caiva klītakaṃ dvididhaṃ smṛtam //
avimūtraṃ satiktaṃ syāt snigdhaṃ pittāvirodhi ca /
kaṇḍūṃ ca śamayet pītaṃ samyagdoṣodare hitam //
hāstikaṃ lavaṇaṃ mūtraṃ hitaṃ tu krimikuṣṭhinām //
ataḥ kṣīrāṇi vakṣyante karma caiṣāṃ guṇāśca ye //
prāyaśo madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ śītaṃ stanyaṃ payo matam /
prīṇanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vṛṣyaṃ medhyaṃ balyaṃ manaskaram //
hanti śoṇitapittaṃ ca sandhānaṃ vihatasya ca //
tṛṣṇāghnaṃ dīpanīyaṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ kṣīṇakṣateṣu ca //
atīsāre jvare dāhe śvayathau ca viśeṣataḥ //
virecane snehane ca payaḥ sarvatra yujyate //
pūtīkaḥ kṛṣṇagandhā ca tilvakaśca tathā taruḥ //
mūtraṃ kṣīrāṇi vṛkṣāśca ṣaḍ ye diṣṭapayastvacaḥ //
puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ vīkṣya sa jñeyo bhiṣaguttamaḥ //
bheṣajaṃ cāpi duryuktaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ saṃpadyate viṣam //
gṛhītamannaṃ pānaṃ vā vittaṃ vā rogapīḍitāt //
sa caiva bhiṣajāṃ śreṣṭho rogebhyo yaḥ pramocayet //
mūtraṃ kṣīrāṇi vṛkṣāśca ṣaḍ ye kṣīratvagāśrayāḥ /
vaidyāpavādo yatrasthāḥ sarve ca bhiṣajāṃ guṇāḥ /
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte sūtrasthāne dīrghañjīvitīyo nāma prathamo 'adhyāyaḥ /
